stops.title: Atɛndans Ripɔt
stops.caption: Pɛ wik, pɛ branch.
stops.speech: Atɛndans ripɔt de sho chɛk-in pɛ wik agens difrɛn mɛmba, we de sɛpret di sem pipul we de kam ɔltɛm frɔm mɔ pipul we de kam.

stops.title: Udat Nɔ De
stops.caption: Sɔt bay aw lɔng.
stops.speech: Di misin mɛmba lis sɔt bay omɔch sɛvis pɔsin dɔn mis wan afta di ɔda, we na di lis we pastɔral kia nid fɔ tru.
